critical_code_review_comments: seed_database asset-hydration block writes has_full_content=True but the /api/courses/{slug} response omitted it (returned None) for the freshly-hydrated course — the DB doc DOES have has_full_content=True, so likely a response-model projection issue. Cosmetic, but if the frontend ever gated a UI element on that field via the detail endpoint it would misbehave. Recommend making the Pydantic response model include has_full_content or ensuring the field always round-trips.

paths_router.ROLE_PATHS is hard-coded in the module — course_slugs could drift from actual seeded course slugs and be silently dropped by the {'$in': [...]} query. Recommend a startup assertion that every path.course_slugs entry resolves to a course, or at least log a WARN when it doesn't (today: silent).

GET /api/courses list-endpoint response omits the 'modules' key entirely (returns [] appearance), which is expected for a list view, but callers cannot distinguish 'empty course' from 'list-view stripped' — currently the has_full_content flag disambiguates. Fine, but worth a code comment on the endpoint for future maintainers.
